name: Eswatini
capital: Mbabane (administrative capital); Lobamba (royal and legislative capital)

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: political parties exist but conditions for their operations, particularly in elections, are undefined, legally unclear, or culturally restricted; the following are considered political associations:
African United Democratic Party or AUDP
Ngwane National Liberatory Congress or NNLC
People's United Democratic Movement or PUDEMO

profile.religions: Christian 90% (Zionist - a blend of Christianity and traditional African religions - 40%, Roman Catholic 20%, other Christian 30% - includes Anglican, Methodist, Church of Jesus Christ, Jehovah's Witness), Muslim 2%, other 8% (includes Baha'i, Buddhist, Hindu, indigenous, Jewish) (2015 est.)
profile.legalSystem: mixed system of civil, common, and customary law
profile.location: Southern Africa, between Mozambique and South Africa
